name: Function International Public Company Limited
summary: Function International Public Company Limited (FTI.BK) specializes in the manufacturing, importation, and wholesale distribution of a comprehensive range of water purification and treatment systems, serving customers in Thailand and around the world. Their diverse product line encompasses household items like water purifiers, RO systems, and filters, as well as commercial-grade equipment such as purifiers, dispensers, water vending machines, and specialized water makers. For industrial needs, they supply advanced RO systems and tanks, along with essential components like pumps and valves. The company markets these products under a broad spectrum of brands, including Aquatek, Star Pure, Hydro Max, Treatton, Unipure, Fast Pure, BIO MAX, Dosag Pump, Ultratek, CNP, HP Watermaker, PENTAIR, RUN-XIN, SUEZ, and VONTRON. Founded in 1997, Function International is headquartered in Khlong Sam Wa, Thailand.
